subject: Joint webinar + Summit sponsorship opportunity with TechBridge
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah@techbridge.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
Cc: Emily Cho <emily@techbridge.io>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership idea — joint integration roundtable + Summit sponsorship

Hi Jonas,

Quick intro — I’m Sarah (Head of Partnerships at TechBridge). We’ve been using Redwood in a few POCs and we’d love to explore a joint go-to-market: a technical roundtable/webinar focused on integrations (how ISVs embed inference cheaply & securely), plus a co-sponsored session at the West Coast Cloud Summit in September.

High level asks:
- A 45-minute joint webinar (tech + product) in June-July.
- A co-branded talk slot at the Summit (15–30 min) and a sponsored lounge table.
- Joint promotional plan (email/social <-> 4 weeks pre-event).

We can provide a customer case study, speaker slides, and run paid social for a combined push. I attached a short outline of the roundtable and a draft SOW we normally use for partner co-markets.

Do you have 20 minutes this week to sync? Happy to loop Emily (cc’d) — she runs events.

Best,
Sarah Lin
Head of Partnerships, TechBridge
(sarah@techbridge.io)

Attachments: TechBridge_joint-webinar-outline.pdf, TB_SOW-draft.docx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah@techbridge.io>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership idea — joint integration roundtable + Summit sponsorship

Hi Sarah — great to hear and glad TechBridge liked the POC results. I’m definitely interested.

A few quick answers:
- Webinar: yes, we can do a 45-minute technical session. We usually do a short demo + panel + live Q&A.
- Summit: we run a small partner budget for co-sponsorships — need to check availability for the 15–30 minute slot.
- Promo: marketing is happy to coordinate.

Can we tentatively target June 25 or July 9 for the webinar? I’ll check internal availability and loop in our Head of Field Marketing, Neha, and Ben from Partner Field Eng for the logistics.

20–30 min tomorrow works for me (Tue 13th) at 9:30am PT if that fits.

Jonas
Sr. Alliances Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.inference
